messages.content: what is the latest news in AI today

Artificial intelligence refers to software systems that perform tasks typically requiring human-like reasoning — recognising patterns, making decisions, generating language, or solving problems. Modern AI is largely built on machine learning: statistical models trained on large datasets rather than hand-coded rules.

Machine learning is a branch of AI where models learn patterns from data rather than following explicit instructions. Given enough examples, a model can generalise to new inputs — the basis of everything from image recognition to language models.
